name: PASCAL Visual Object Classes (PASCAL VOC 2012)
description: The foundational benchmark dataset created by the PASCAL Network of Excellence for standardized object category detection, image classification, semantic segmentation, and human action recognition. The final VOC2012 challenge release contains 11,530 meticulously annotated real-world images containing 27,450 object bounding boxes and pixel-accurate semantic masks across 20 distinct visual object categories spanning person, animals, vehicles, and indoor objects.
